title: Dazzle Wants to Turn Your Camera Roll Into an AI Assistant
text: Dazzle is betting the next generation of personal AI should know more about you before you even ask a question. The startup uses photos and screenshots in a user’s camera roll to understand their interests, relationships, travel and belongings — then helps take actions, from finding a product and arranging a repair to planning activities or adding an event to a calendar. Dazzle CEO Marissa Mayer joins Ed Ludlow for more on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
